title: One reader of what a lane brief is: lane-one-topic and brief-ids-in-roster both read any line, not line one only
why: Lane brief-ids-from-roster (relayed 00:05 CST Nov 14; hooks/guard_merge.py brief_hit vs brief_roster_hit, PR #3352; unchecked by triage): the new check brief-ids-in-roster reads a Grant:/Lane brief: opener on any line; lane-one-topic reads line one only, so a heading above a brief skips the topic check but not the id check.
source: Lane message to triage 00:05 CST Nov 14 (relayed). Rule building-one-home-per-capability.
